messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Availability was checked only for 2025-10-12..15 (confirmed); the change is made to 2025-10-11..14, never checked or confirmed.", "verifier": {"reason": "The new dates (2025-10-11 to 2025-10-14) must be confirmed available for the room type `deluxe_double` via `check_availability` before executing `change_dates`. — The assistant confirmed availability for **12–15 October** (h36) but executed `change_dates` for **11–14 October** (t0) without verifying availability for those exact dates."}}
